notes:
ACCURACY: 4/25 wrong, all source-level, none invented: iFi Audio and Moon by Simaudio cite the EISA history index (https://www.eisa-awards.org/history/hi-fi/), which names no brands; Clearaudio cites the container category 'Audio equipment manufacturers by country' (it is listed in the Germany subcategory); Chario cites the Stereophile 2026 loudspeakers page, where it appears only under Deletions (it is listed on the 2025 page). SYSTEMATIC FIXES: (1) all 24 EISA Hi-Fi rows share the index-page src: repoint each to its year page (iFi 2018-19/2020-21/2022-23/2023-24/2024-25; Moon 2022-23 as 'MOON Voice 22 & ACE'; MoFi 2019-20 UltraDeck+M and 2023-24 SourcePoint 8; Hegel 2019-20 H390 etc.; mapping in AUDIT_D3_tmp/raw/ey_*.md).
